post.description: The post, page or custom post type entry whose Meta Box field values are being written.

fields.description: The fields to write, at most 50, each named once. Every entry is validated before any of them is written: one entry this operation cannot use refuses the whole request and leaves the post untouched.

field.description: One Meta Box field id. In Meta Box a field's id is the meta key its value is stored under, and its name is the human label shown on the editing screen; this argument takes the id, not the label. Call metabox-field-list for the post to see the ids the fields on it carry.

value.description: The value to store, in the raw form Meta Box stores rather than a formatted one: an attachment id rather than an attachment object, a post id rather than a post. Its type follows the field, so none is declared here. Send an empty list [] to clear a clonable or group field, and an empty string to clear a text field.

plan.description: The change plan to approve, including its plan token.

target.description: The concrete target that was written.

changed.description: The fields the approved plan changed.

state.description: The verified persisted state of the target.
